scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute powernet-esg --local --file=db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute powernet-esg --local --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute powernet-esg --remote --file=db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute powernet-esg --remote --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.db:count: wrangler d1 execute powernet-esg --local --command="SELECT entity_code, COUNT(*) AS monthly FROM v_expected_entry WHERE period_type='monthly' GROUP BY 1"
